pc_sampling.scope: Menu plus one complete first search; function attribution is approximate across 64-byte buckets

limits: Sleep was checked on USB power; batteries are not installed.
UART queue ordering is checked under host concurrency and real device load; no external UART receiver was attached.
STM32 checks are builds/APPs/memory/runtime gates, without STM32 hardware flashing.
The measured firmware keeps GCC IEEE arithmetic; separate owned-M0 runtime development is not included.
